labelOverrides.title: Label overrides
labelOverrides.boundary: Drydock stores these values and applies them on top of Docker labels. It never edits Compose files or recreates the container.

scope.containerAgent: Applies to container {name} on agent {agent}, watcher {watcher}.
scope.composeService: Applies to Compose service {name}, {count} container, watcher {watcher}. | Applies to Compose service {name}, {count} containers, watcher {watcher}.
scope.composeServiceAgent: Applies to Compose service {name}, {count} container, agent {agent}, watcher {watcher}. | Applies to Compose service {name}, {count} containers, agent {agent}, watcher {watcher}.

labelOverrides.noOverrides: No overrides. Every value comes from a label, Compose, the watcher or a default.
labelOverrides.unavailable: Label overrides are not available for this container.

readOnly.rollback: This is a temporary rollback container. Its label overrides can't be changed.
readOnly.forbidden: Admin access is required to change label overrides. This view is read-only.

editor.displayNameHelp: 1 to 128 characters. Shown instead of the container name.
editor.iconNameHelp: Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore. Use a name from the icon source, not a URL.
editor.scopeReminder: Saving changes the value for everything in the scope shown above.

displayName.invalidCharacters: Remove control characters, direction marks, < and >.

validation.iconName: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore, starting with a letter or number.

conflict.message: These overrides were changed somewhere else. Reload to see the current values. Your draft is kept.
conflict.unknown: Drydock could not confirm whether the change was saved. Reload to see the current values.
conflict.notFound: This container no longer exists. Reload to see the current list.

status.resetAll: Reset {count} override to its label value. | Reset {count} overrides to their label values.

resetAllConfirm.message: Remove every Drydock override for {scope} and go back to the label values? Compose files and containers are not touched.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.unresolved-dependency: {field}: {reference} is not a container Drydock knows yet.
warnings.trigger-agent-mismatch: {field}: {reference} only matches triggers on another agent.
warnings.auto-inert: {field}: {reference} matches no trigger that runs automatically.
warnings.stale-trigger-reference: {field}: {reference} no longer matches a registered trigger.

labelOverrides.invalidStored: Some stored overrides could not be read and are ignored: {fields}

errors.unknown: Could not save the label override

codes.display-name-invalid-characters: Remove control characters, direction marks, < and >.
codes.invalid-icon: Use an icon source and a name, not a URL.
